device: HTC HD2 / Leo, 480x800, single-core Scorpion, Adreno 200
result: full Smartisan icon-cell flip restored for app open and close while retaining face, edge and shadow content

animation.window_fallback: 95 ms incoming surface with 2 percent travel; light desktop return zoom
animation.unlock: single-pass 7-frame staggered reveal with duplicate broadcast debounce

performance_fix.root_cause: writing interactive/min_sample_time hangs in this HD2 kernel and left hd2-runtime consuming about 96 percent of the only CPU
performance_fix.resolution: do not write that sysfs node; allow oneshot to finish; retry mkswap+swapon when zram disksize exists without a valid swap header

comparison.before: Settings warm launch: 30 skipped frames, Displayed +1.528s
comparison.after: same tested path: no skipped-frame record, Displayed +1.093s

known_limit: a legacy PMEM mapping error can still appear later in some Settings cold starts; it also occurred without the flip and is not an overflow of the 158x432 flip content in the 256x512 atlas
